en.metron.config.title: Metron
en.metron.config.subtitle: Comic metadata from Metron.
en.metron.config.apiToken_hint: A token from the API Tokens section of your own Metron account page. Fliks ships none: without one the provider stays inactive. Metron allows 20 requests per minute and 5,000 per day per account.
en.metron.config.attribution: Data from Metron (https://metron.cloud), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Some series carry their own attribution on Metron.
